name: card_num
description: Card number. Each card is an improvement/building on the parcel

name: proration_key_pin
description: Tieback key PIN. Prorated properties (whose value is split across multiple PINs) have a "main" or key PIN

name: pin_proration_rate
description: Tieback proration rate. Prorated properties (whose value is split across multiple PINs) pay taxes on the proportion of value on their PIN. In other words, assessed value is multiplied by proration rate to determine taxable assessed value

name: card_proration_rate
description: Card proration rate. Prorated parcels (whose value is split across multiple cards) pay taxes on the proportion of value on their card. In other words, assessed value is multiplied by proration rate to determine taxable assessed value. Cards are divisions within parcels, such as one of multiple buildings on a single parcel.

name: cdu
description: Condition, Desirability, and Utility code. Not well maintained.

name: pin_is_multicard
description: Multicard PIN. Indicates whether the parcel contains more than one building (ADU, coach house, etc.)

name: pin_num_cards
description: Number of cards on this parcel. Each card is an improvement/building

name: pin_is_multiland
description: Multiland PIN. Indicates whether parcel has more than one landline

name: pin_num_landlines
description: Number of landlines on a parcel. The sum of all landline square footage should be equal to the total square footage of the parcel. Each landline can correspond to a different land price/rate

name: building_sqft
description: Building square feet. Square footage of the building, as measured from the exterior

name: land_sqft
description: Land square feet. Square footage of the land (not just the building) of the property. Note that a single PIN can have multiple landlines, meaning it can be associated with more than one land price/rate

name: num_rooms
description: Rooms. Number of total rooms in the building (excluding baths). Not to be confused with bedrooms

name: num_full_baths
description: Full baths. Defined as having a bath or shower. If this value is missing, the default value is set to 1

name: num_half_baths
description: Half baths. Defined as bathrooms without a shower or bathtub

name: num_fireplaces
description: Fireplaces. Counted as the number of flues one can see from the outside of the building

name: num_apartments
description: Apartments. Number of apartments for class 211 and 212 properties

name: garage_area_included
description: Is Garage 1 physically included within the building area? If yes, the garage area is subtracted from the building square feet calculation by the field agent

name: num_commercial_units
description: Number of commercial units on the parcel (the vast majority are for properties with class 212)
